settings.name: Dr. Spencer Proctor
settings.role: Professor & Department Chair, University of Alberta
settings.bio: Dr. Spencer Proctor specializes in nutritional sciences, biomedical research, sports nutrition and intestinal absorption. An athlete and coach, he helps guide Best Hydrate's scientific direction across performance and clinical hydration.

settings.name: Austin
settings.bio: Austin founded Best Hydrate after a serious health experience changed how he thought about hydration. A boiler engineer, builder and entrepreneur, he began developing the formula in 2020 around a simple idea: better hydration needs the right balance of water, electrolytes and nutrition.

settings.name: Simone
settings.bio: Simone is a Registered Nurse with 16 years in research and management. She co-founded Best Hydrate to bring a practical health-care perspective to everyday hydration.

settings.heading: Meet Us
settings.text: Best Hydrate brings together lived experience, health care, science and performance.
